profiles.name: Companion horse or pony
profiles.basis: Editorial game interpretation of the linked species care guidance.
profiles.description: You want a companion and appear prepared to manage a field.
profiles.care: Needs equine companions, suitable pasture and shelter, daily checks and handling, farrier visits, and equine veterinary care. Non-ridden does not mean inexpensive.

profiles.name: Domestic goats
profiles.basis: Editorial game interpretation of the linked species care guidance.
profiles.description: For someone whose outdoor space and fencing can support actual goats.
profiles.care: Need suitable goat companions, secure land and fencing, shelter, hoof care, and ongoing livestock veterinary support.

profiles.name: Bearded dragon
profiles.basis: Editorial game interpretation of the linked species care guidance.
profiles.description: A reptile for someone who enjoys managing a proper habitat.
profiles.care: Requires a spacious vivarium, controlled temperature, suitable UVB lighting and a diet including insects and plant foods.

profiles.name: Corn snake
profiles.basis: Editorial game interpretation of the linked species care guidance.
profiles.description: A quiet companion with specialist housing and feeding needs.
profiles.care: Needs a secure, temperature-controlled vivarium and a suitable whole-prey feeding plan.

profiles.name: Leopard gecko
profiles.basis: Editorial game interpretation of the linked species care guidance.
profiles.description: A quieter reptile for observation and careful, limited handling.
profiles.care: Needs a correctly heated vivarium, appropriate lighting, hides, and live insect food.

profiles.name: Royal python (ball python)
profiles.basis: Editorial game interpretation of the linked species care guidance.
profiles.description: A quiet snake for a keeper comfortable with specialist care.
profiles.care: Needs a secure vivarium with carefully managed temperature and humidity, hides, and appropriate whole-prey feeding.

profiles.name: Chinchilla
profiles.basis: Editorial game interpretation of the linked species care guidance.
profiles.description: Quiet, active, and more comfortable with gentle interaction than restraint.
profiles.care: Plan for compatible company, a cool environment, suitable dust baths, and a spacious enclosure.

profiles.name: Degu
profiles.basis: Editorial game interpretation of the linked species care guidance.
profiles.description: Social and curious, with a need for daily enrichment.
profiles.care: Keep compatible company and provide a large enriched enclosure, daily interaction, and a species-appropriate diet.

profiles.name: Domestic ferret
profiles.basis: Editorial game interpretation of the linked species care guidance.
profiles.description: Curious and playful. Your cabinets will need a plan.
profiles.care: Ferrets need compatible company, secure housing, daily supervised exercise and specialist diet and veterinary planning.

profiles.name: Domestic mouse
profiles.basis: Editorial game interpretation of the linked species care guidance.
profiles.description: An active little animal often most interesting to watch.
profiles.care: Plan housing and compatible company carefully for the sex and individuals; provide hiding and foraging opportunities.

profiles.name: Domestic rabbit
profiles.basis: Editorial game interpretation of the linked species care guidance.
profiles.description: Social, active, and best interacted with at floor level.
profiles.care: Plan for a compatible rabbit companion, ample exercise space, hay, enrichment, and regular care. Many rabbits dislike being picked up.

profiles.name: Domestic rat
profiles.basis: Editorial game interpretation of the linked species care guidance.
profiles.description: Intelligent, social, and interested in what you are doing.
profiles.care: Keep compatible rats together and provide daily interaction, a suitable enclosure, and enrichment.

profiles.name: Guinea pig
profiles.basis: Editorial game interpretation of the linked species care guidance.
profiles.description: A social companion with plenty to say about dinner.
profiles.care: Keep compatible companions; provide space, hay and vitamin C. Small does not mean low maintenance.

profiles.name: Mongolian gerbil
profiles.basis: Editorial game interpretation of the linked species care guidance.
profiles.description: Busy diggers who are entertaining to observe.
profiles.care: Keep a compatible established pair or group with deep digging material and enrichment.

profiles.name: Syrian hamster
profiles.basis: Editorial game interpretation of the linked species care guidance.
profiles.description: An evening companion who values personal space.
profiles.care: Syrian hamsters generally live alone. Provide a substantial enclosure with deep bedding, enrichment, and an appropriate wheel. Expect evening activity.
